description: Defines output data classes for verified email responses in a NestJS API, including success/error status and data structures for user and team verified emails.

classes.name: UserVerifiedEmailOutputData
classes.description: Data structure for individual user verified email output.

classes.name: TeamVerifiedEmailOutputData
classes.description: Data structure for individual team verified email output.

classes.name: TeamVerifiedEmailOutput
classes.description: Response wrapper for team verified email status and data.

classes.name: UserVerifiedEmailOutput

classes.name: TeamVerifiedEmailsOutput
